en: "You feel it, {name:6}?"
"Yes, I sense somethiing."
"The air is drawn tight.{n} This is magic power, isn't it?"
"Yes."
"Something feels strange heere.{n} What do you think, Mr. {hero:6}?"
"That's Holy Knight blood for you.{n} I've been feeling it for{n} a while now, too..."
"A heavy feeling that squeezes my chest.{n} It's like that drawn-tight air{n} when someone casts magiic."
"Yeah. This place is brimming with{n} magic power. In the ground,{n} and in the air."
"That haze... is it a mass{n} of magic power!?"
"That haze...{n} It seems to be a mass of magic power!?"
"Gohhh... Gohhh..."
"Please look! A monster,{n} coming out of the haze!?"
"A person!? No, it isn't!?"
"What the hell is this thing!?{n} It's a living creature, no mistake.{n} But that shape is far too bizarre!"
"A horse's head, and the arms{n} of all sorts of creatures?"
"Gohhh... Gohhh..."
"I can't believe it... that voice!?"
"It's no horse's voice, and no human's!{n} No, it's like every living thing,{n} and yet like none of them!?"
"To be honest, Mr. {hero:6},{n} I'm so scared I'm shakiing!"
"I know just how you feel!"
"What a sinister shape it has..."
"And on top of that, it's way too big.{n} A monster like this... it's the first{n} I've seen since I came to this island!?"
"Could it be!?"
"Could this be another of the ancient{n} weapons called Machine Gods that{n} appeared a hundred years ago!?"
"No, the Machine Gods aren't living{n} things. On the outside, at least,{n} they looked like machines!"
"Then?"
"A giant monster, thrown together{n} from every kind of creature,{n} that still keeps a human shape."
"Call it a Machine Man, I guess!?"
"A Machine Man..."
"But I can sense tremendous{n} magic power coming from{n} that monster's body!?"
"It's probably a giant synthesized{n} with magic power. A Composite{n} Machine Man, you might call it!"
"A Composite Machine Man..."
"What could that wall of light be?"
"The Absolute Field..."
"Huh?"
"A barrier that scatters magic power and{n} nullifies it. They say the Machine God{n} of a hundred years ago had the same."
"The army has been researching it all{n} this time, to work out the principle and{n} make an artificial magic barrier, but..."
"Then against that Machine Man, magic and{n} special attacks would both...?"
"...be completely useless!"
"What is that? That wall of light?"
"It's a magic barrier!"
"What?"
"I once heard about it from my father."
"That a very few of the magic beasts{n} in the frontier lands are born with a wall{n} that blocks magic and special attacks."
"A wall that blocks magic..."
"Come to think of it, I've heard of one too.{n} The wall that blocks magic completely,{n} used by the Machine God 100 years ago."
"The Absolute Field."
"But for a misshapen creature like that{n} to have an anti-magic barrier..."
"Listen up! Concentrate every attack{n} you've got and hit it all at once!{n} Direct attacks only!"
"Let's go!"
"Magic doesn't work on that giant!{n} We fight with direct attacks only!{n} Now then, everyone, let us go!"
"No waaay!? Direct attacks!?{n} Alice is super-duper{n} bad at thooose!"
"Alice's life is Prince {hero:6}'s!{n} Even if my body gets torn to bits,{n} Alice will fight her very best!"
"A foe against whom magic is useless...{n} In this battle, attacks from afar{n} shall likely be the key to victory..."
"C'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon c'mon!{n} Anybody who ain't sure of{n} their skills, stay back!"
"Magic barrier or whatever the hell{n} it is, my heavy MG is gonna{n} do damage, guaranteed!"
"Magic... is nothing but... trickery...{n} ...With my... knife... I should{n} be able to cut... any enemy..."
"The Absolute Field, is it? This is{n} indeed an unfavorable battle for me."
"In the Ordoba War a hundred years ago,{n} too, I recall being sorely troubled by{n} a Machine God with the same barrier..."
"The cheek of it, having a magic barrier!{n} But I'm good at hand-to-hand too!{n} Behold! This beautiful technique!"
"Hiyaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
"Urk!?"
"I've gone and hurt my back a bit!{n} And so, don't go putting me{n} out in front too much, you hear!"
"The enemy's estimated combat power is..."
"No, measuring its combat power is{n} pointless. It is certain, at least, that{n} our current forces cannot defeat it."
"However, we have made the impossible{n} possible many times before. This time,{n} too, we should surely be able to win..."
"How ferocious!? How evil!?{n} I have never felt ki{n} as sinister as this!?"
"Ah! The dreadful form of that giant{n} is the very image of{n} the devil of legend!"
"But as a priest, a servant of God,{n} I will fight! To seal away and{n} destroy this devil incarnate!"
"Truly, what a hooorrid monster!{n} Compared to that, do look, if you please!{n} At the adorable figure of Li'l Tethys!"
"Oh? That is right, yes indeed!{n} We are in the middle{n} of a battle right now!"
"This truly is the Demon Plateau, sir!{n} To think such an eerie monster{n} would come out of the haze!?"
"Kh! This is no time to be afraid!{n} Now is the time to show the pride,{n} and the courage, of a Romulus soldier!"
"It's the Absolute Field! Just as{n} I thought, magic doesn't work on it!"
"It's no use after all! Every kind of{n} magic gets blocked by that barrieer!"
"Even so, I am astonished.{n} This creature's anti-magic barrier is{n} stronger still than the Machine God's."
"Keh! Didn't I damn well tell you!?{n} Leave it to me! I'll blow{n} the thing apart from long range!"
"As I thought... I must dive in close...{n} ...and with my own... hands...{n} carve it up... so it seems..."
"No woorries! Do leave it to me!{n} As a matter of fact, Li'l Tethys is{n} good at direct attacks too, yes indeed!"
"All right! Physical attacks are the{n} only way after all! Those with guns,{n} aim from long range!"
"I felt that one hiit!{n} Just as I thought, direct attacks{n} seem to do damaage!"
"Tch, it's got close-combat moves too!{n} Never thought it'd even breathe fire!{n} We can't just walk up to this thing!"
"It even breathes fiire!?{n} Magic is no good, close combat is no{n} good... Aaaahn! What do we dooo!?"
"Get lost, you ugly monster bastard!"
"Somehow... it looks like we beat iit!"
"Ngh!?"
"Well, well. That was splendidly done."
"Oh? And who might you be?"
"You two are a truly lovely work of art.{n} One finished whole made of two.{n} An imbalance of clashing light and dark."
"Huuh?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"So, who are you?"
"So, why are you here?"
"What do you mean by that?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"Um, excuse me, buut..."
"Who might you beee?"
"Why are you heere?"
"What does that meaan?"
"So, who are you?"
"If humans are to call me something,{n} Ymir. Still, names to tell each{n} individual apart were a fine invention."
"So, why are you here?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What's that supposed to mean?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"Tch, what's all this babbling about?{n} Good grief. Is this brat{n} cracked in the head or what?"
"And who might you be, I wondeer?"
"If humans must call me something:{n} Ymir. Names are a useful thing{n} for telling each individual apart."
"Why are you here, I wondeer?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What do you mean by thaat?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"U-ummm, I haven't the faintest{n} idea what you're talking abouut?"
"Oh my, you're the one{n} from the other day?"
"Tch, you again."
"Hey, you, brat. Why have you been{n} tailing us this whole time?"
"Following you? No, you are mistaken.{n} I am the one who bears the name Ymir.{n} Your guide, so to speak."
"A guide?"
"Guide us to what?"
"What do you mean?"
"Don't screw with me!"
"A guide, you saay?"
"A guide to whaat?"
"What do you meaan?"
"How interestiing."
"And what is it you're guiding us to?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"Heh, that makes no damn sense."
"And what's that supposed to mean?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Heh, mind your own business."
"Heh, don't screw with me!"
"By arriving at an answer like that,{n} you make the limits of your thinking{n} all the clearer to see."
"Haah? What the hell are you on about?{n} You got a screw loose somewhere{n} in that head of yours?"
"What will you be guiding us tooo?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"R-riight...?"
"What does that meaan?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Yees... I'm sooorry..."
"What an interesting answeer."
"'Interesting' is a perception, too.{n} By that perception and by feeling, you{n} strive to make sense of the baffling."
"You're the one from the other day?"
"We truly do meet often, do we not?"
"But is this a coincidence, I wondeer?"
"Who knows..."
"Even so..."
"That truly was a monster{n} of fearsome form."
"But fearsome as it looked,{n} was that truly a creature{n} of ill will, I wonder?"
"What are you getting at?"
"Oh, nothing. You say that humans must{n} not be judged by appearance. I think{n} the same is true of creatures."
"Heh. So that thing was really a good{n} creature, and we decided it was evil{n} just from how it looked..."
"And you're saying that's wrong?"
"No, I do not say it is wrong.{n} When little information is given,{n} humans first consult their memories."
"If the creature before them resembles{n} an evil being in their memories, they{n} judge that it, too, must be evil."
"Good and evil must not be judged by{n} form, but by something deeper. That{n} is what you want to say, isn't it?"
"People think this world holds only two{n} things, good and evil. That is why strife{n} arises, and enemies and allies are born..."
"That is what you mean, yes?"
"Hee hee. It is just as I thought.{n} You appear to be a far wiser{n} human than you look."
"The 'than you look' part{n} was uncalled fooor!"
"Yes, that too is a judgment by{n} appearance. It is wrong, certainly."
"But it cannot be helped."
"Humans reason by analogy from past{n} experience, and sort all things{n} into a simple dualism."
"Were it otherwise, complex values{n} might lead the human heart astray{n} and throw its compass off course."
"Simplifying, reducing to symbols: this{n} is the sum of human wisdom so far, and{n} it is why humans were able to advance."
"But humans seek higher advancement,{n} and with their own hands are trying to{n} bring forth an ever more complex world."
"The growing complexity of the world's{n} systems. It resembles the growing{n} complexity of life."
"Seen from the simple, the complex{n} may seem advanced, but in truth{n} it is also a very fragile thing."
"Lose a single piece, and in an{n} instant it all comes crumbling down..."
"That's quite a difficult subject,{n} isn't it."
"Pay it no mind. It's just parroted{n} from some book. Worthless talk that{n} won't even put food on the table."
"Hee hee. That may well be so.{n} But even words parroted from a book{n} can be a spur to thinking."
"The conclusion reached after thinking{n} is each human's own truth,{n} within each human's heart."
"Heh. Said whatever he wanted{n} and took right off!"
"But doesn't what that child said{n} stay on your mind, somehow?"
"That talk comparing the simple{n} and the complex?"
"Growing more complex is a road humans{n} can't avoid as they go on living.{n} It's the inevitable result."
"Just like simple, primitive creatures{n} took the road to complexity{n} in search of higher functions."
"Mr. {hero:6}, you're so learneed!"
"Are you making fun of me?"
"No, I'm amaazed!"
"Heh!"
"Things growing more complex, hmmm..."
"True, compared with long, long ago,{n} humans have built quite{n} a complex society, buut..."
"Quit brooding over every little thing!"
"Where do we come from?{n} What are we?{n} Where are we going?"
"I've heard that line somewhere."
"It's a question Hector held. I hear it{n} began as the words a certain painter{n} entrusted to his own painting."
"That's Gauguin.{n} A painter who died in 4003."
"Myyy, you know a lot, don't yoou?"
"It reminded me of something{n} a certain man said, too."
"That man said it's the complicated{n} human heart that gives birth to war.{n} That was a long, long time ago, though..."
"Well, shall we be going now?"
"Yeah. We've got no business here."
"What the hell was that thing!?"
"Could it have been... a person!?"
"Don't be stupid. No way a monster{n} like that could be human!"
"No... of course not..."
"Even so..."
"What an eerie enemy that was."
"No kidding. Even I felt{n} a bit of a chill..."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
